rows.Kwic: 舉：拘留孫佛云：見身無實是佛身，了心如幻是佛幻，了得身心本性空，斯人與佛何殊別？師云：佛身無實亦無虗，佛幻非幻。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Hengchuan Xinggong (橫川行珙禪師語錄). Hengchuan Xinggong explicitly raises a verse with 'Krakucchanda Buddha said'; Krakucchanda Buddha is therefore the exact quoted speaker of the headword-bearing line about realizing the original nature of body and mind as empty. Hengchuan follows with his own comment.
